attributes.name: Druva - Dormant Administrator Became Active
attributes.description: Detects a Druva administrator account that was disabled because of prolonged inactivity and later successfully authenticates. This may indicate unexpected reactivation or use of a dormant privileged account.
author: Druva

meta.customer_usecase: Detects a Druva administrator account that was disabled because of prolonged inactivity and later successfully authenticates. This may indicate unexpected reactivation or use of a dormant privileged account.

attributes.query:
sequence by user.email with maxspan=90d
  [ any where druva.feature == "Admin Event"
      and druva.event_type == "Administrator Disabled" ]
  [ any where druva.feature == "Admin Event"
      and druva.event_type == "Admin Login"
      and event.outcome == "success" ]
